2D scan matching with ICP

This notebook uses the MRPT Python wheel (pip install mrpt3) to align two simulated 2D laser scans with the Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm. It uses three MRPT modules:
  • mrpt.poses: SE(2) poses (CPose2D) and their Gaussian uncertainty (CPosePDFGaussian).
  • mrpt.maps: point clouds (CSimplePointsMap), filled from NumPy arrays.
  • mrpt.slam: the ICP algorithm (CICP).
A robot takes a 360° scan, moves, and takes a second one. ICP estimates that motion from the two scans alone, starting from a zero initial guess (as if there were no odometry). Move the sliders: everything below is recomputed. Try large rotations, or a small matching distance, to see when ICP gets stuck in a wrong solution.
